messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall-net: SEV2 — elevated 502/504 rate from edge ELB in eu-west-1d (observed 5m). Affected path: /v1/generate. Auto-created incident INC-2026-879.

oncall-net: acked. jumping in.

sophia: seeing 5xx spike in dashboards. ELB 5xx count up x12 in last 3m, backend target health toggling to Unhealthy in azd.

marcus: grabbing logs from the edge proxy. attaching a short curl test from inside eu-west-1d (local GCE host):

```
$ curl -i https://edge-eu-west-1.example.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Connection: close
Server: awselb/2.0
```

eng-sre-lead: same. ELB metrics show increased TargetConnectionErrors and UnhealthyHostCount for target group tg-prod-api-eu-west-1d. No obvious WAF change.

oncall-net: running quick dig on route53 name from several locations:

```
$ dig +short edge-eu-west-1.example.com @8.8.8.8
54.72.12.33
54.72.12.34
(consistent)
```

oncall-net: traceroute from edge proxy -> backend VM shows TTL hits and then multiple * at hop 6 consistently in azd fabric. suspect ENI/ARP or host-level network flaps.

incident-bot: Note — AWS reported increased EC2 hypervisor networking errors in eu-west-1d earlier today (public bulletin link: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/xxxx).

sophia: Confirming a cluster of EC2s with high kernel drop counters in eu-west-1d. I can drain targets in the tg-prod-api-eu-west-1d to avoid mis-routed connections. Thoughts?

marcus: +1 drain. Start draining targets in that AZ only, keep AZ-level TTLs stable. We'll shift weighted Route53 traffic away from azd to azb/azc while we mitigate.

eng-sre-lead: Agreement: Do a gradual 20% -> 50% traffic shift to other AZs via weighted records, then to 100% if health doesn't recover within 10m. Update runbook: runbook/network/az-network-partition.md step 3.

oncall-net: issuing Route53 weighted change now (weights: azd=10, azb=45, azc=45). Propagation target: immediate TTL 30s.

incident-bot: Change submitted: Route53 change ID C123456789, requested by oncall-net.

customer-success: Notified major customers A and B via status page template, flagged any SLA impact. Some customers reporting timeouts in EU.

marcus: draining targets: aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:...tg-prod-api-eu-west-1d --targets Id=i-0abcde12345 Id=i-0fedcba98765

sophia: health checks now failing for the same instances -> marking unhealthy faster; backend error rate drops ~40% after partial shift. ELB 5xx rate trending down.

oncall-net: still seeing intermittent connection resets from NAT gateway in azd. opened a support case with AWS (case #987654321). Link pasted in incident ticket.

eng-sre-lead: we should escalate to cross-region failover if AWS case says not recoverable in 30-45m. For now keep monitoring and hold the weighted shift at 100% away from azd if needed.

incident-bot: Incident update posted to INC-2026-879. Priority SEV2. Estimated customer impact: ~12% of EU traffic experienced errors at peak; about 4k requests/min returned 5xx over 8m.

marcus: handing off to next on-call (sophia) in 15m — if we don't see recovery, sophia please coordinate with cloud-eng for IP/EIP re-provision or AZ-level traffic-shed.

sophia: taking over at 12:45 UTC. current state: Route53 weighted change propagated to 100% away from azd, drained targets, ELB 5xxs back down to baseline. Keeping support case open.

customer-success: Will keep customers updated; posting an explanatory note on status page mentioning 'regional EC2 networking degradation in eu-west-1d caused transient errors, mitigation via traffic shift'.

oncall-net: documenting timeline in the incident ticket. Next steps: wait for AWS RCA, reintroduce azd targets only after kernel counters and ENI metrics look healthy for >=15m.

eng-sre-lead: postmortem owners: oncall-net (network sequence), sophia (runbook/action), marcus (customer comms). we'll schedule P0 follow-up within 48h. :calendar: 

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-879 status: Mitigated — monitoring. Last update by sophia at 12:58 UTC.

marcus: thanks team. good coordination. closing the immediate page.

sophia: note for postmortem — consider automated az-level fallback if target group unhealthy rate > X for 2m (to avoid manual weighted shifts).

eng-sre-lead: agreed, adding to Optimize runbook items.

customer-success: confirmed status message live. customers A/B replied with partial relief. :thumbsup:
